##### Project general facts

Rise Villas is a contemporary collection of private pool villas.The villas are designed in a modern tropical style, featuring clean architectural lines, spacious layouts, and high ceilings that enhance natural light and airflow. Each residence includes a private swimming pool and seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces, creating a comfort and functional environment for both everyday living and holiday use.

The development offers a well-rounded range of lifestyle amenities, elevating it beyond a typical villa project. Residents benefit from a 24/7 reception and security, a stylish coffee shop, coworking spaces, and a dedicated commercial area for daily convenience. Wellness and leisure facilities include a fully equipped workout zone, sauna, and magnesium bath, supporting a balanced and healthy lifestyle.

Interiors are thoughtfully crafted with a strong focus on contemporary aesthetics and functionality, often described as some of the most visually appealing and “Instagrammable” in Phuket. Villas are delivered with high-quality finishes, modern kitchens, and fully equipped bathrooms, while furniture packages are designed to complement the overall architectural concept — blending natural textures, neutral tones, and stylish décor elements. The furnishing approach ensures a turnkey solution, allowing owners to immediately use the property for personal living or rental operations without additional setup.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Located on the northwest coast of Phuket, Bang Tao is one of the island’s most sought-after coastal destinations, known for its long stretch of pristine beach and relaxed upscale atmosphere. The area is home to the renowned Laguna Phuket — a fully integrated resort community featuring luxury hotels, golf courses, spas, and high-end residences. Bang Tao Beach itself spans nearly 6 kilometers, offering a quieter alternative to the more vibrant tourist hubs while still maintaining a sophisticated lifestyle appeal.

The district is well-developed with a strong infrastructure, providing residents and visitors with easy access to lifestyle amenities. Within minutes, you’ll find premium dining venues, beach clubs, and shopping destinations such as Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket. The area seamlessly blends leisure and convenience, with international schools, wellness centers, and supermarkets all nearby, making it ideal for both short-term stays and long-term living.

Bang Tao also benefits from excellent connectivity. Phuket International Airport is approximately a 25–30 minute drive away, ensuring easy international access. Its strategic location allows quick connections to neighboring areas such as Surin and Kamala, while still preserving a sense of privacy and exclusivity — making Bang Tao a prime choice for investors and homeowners seeking a balance of tranquility and vibrant coastal living.
